AUDIENCES.DESCRIPTION: Contact lists that keep themselves up to date from a rule and a time window, or fixed lists.
AUDIENCES.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the audiences. Please try again.

STATS.CAMPAIGNS_HINT: used an audience as the target

EMPTY.TITLE: No audiences yet
EMPTY.SUBTITLE: Create an audience from a rule, such as stage and label, or import a CSV list.

AUDIENCES.FOOTNOTE: The number of contacts is always the current one: it goes up and down as contacts enter and leave the rule. The window looks at the date the conversation started.

FORM.DESCRIPTION: Say who should be in it, in which period and who stays out. The rest is automatic.
FORM.REQUIRED_NOTE: Required: name and window. The exclusion is optional.
FORM.NAME_HELP: Just for you to recognize it in the list.
FORM.KIND_DYNAMIC_HELP: A rule: whoever starts meeting it enters, whoever stops meeting it leaves.
FORM.KIND_STATIC_HELP: A photo: keeps today's contacts, and the list only changes by hand.
FORM.RULE_HELP: A contact enters when one of its conversations meets every condition below.
FORM.WINDOW_HELP: Only conversations started within this period count.
FORM.WINDOW_NOTE: "Last days" moves along with time. "Date range" is fixed, good for a report on a closed month.
FORM.EXCLUSION_HELP: Remove from the audience whoever meets any of these conditions, even if they meet the entry rule.
FORM.AUTO_UPDATE_NOTE: Updates by itself, with nobody adding contacts.
FORM.STATIC_NOTE: Keeps today's contacts. Afterwards the list only changes by hand.
FORM.LIVE_NOTE: The size changes as soon as you touch the rule, the window or the exclusion.
FORM.IGNORED: Conditions the audience does not accept were left out: {fields}
FORM.ERROR: Could not save the audience. Check the fields and try again.

SHOW.STATIC_LIST: Fixed list: only changes by hand.
SHOW.OVER_LIMIT: This audience has more than 10 thousand contacts: it cannot be downloaded or used in a campaign. Split it, for example with a smaller window.
SHOW.NO_CONTACTS: No contacts in this audience right now.
SHOW.RULE_NOTE: Meets the rule, enters. Stops meeting it, or falls in the exclusion, leaves. A contact enters through any of its conversations that meets everything.
SHOW.ACTIONS_NOTE: Record of who downloaded the list, which campaigns used this audience and when it was frozen.
SHOW.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: The audience "{name}" will be deleted. The contacts stay in the account.

SNAPSHOT_DIALOG.TITLE: Freeze as a fixed audience
SNAPSHOT_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: Creates a fixed audience with today's {count} contacts. It no longer changes by itself.
SNAPSHOT_DIALOG.NAME: Name of the new audience

ADD_DIALOG.TITLE: Add contacts
ADD_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: Search by name, phone or e-mail and choose the contacts.

IMPORT_DIALOG.TITLE: Import CSV
IMPORT_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: Creates a fixed audience with the spreadsheet's contacts. Required columns: name and phone_number, with the phone starting with +55.
IMPORT_DIALOG.NAME: Audience name
IMPORT_DIALOG.INVALID_ROWS: {count} rows were skipped for invalid data.

DOWNLOAD.TITLE: Download list · {name}
DOWNLOAD.DESCRIPTION: Take the contacts to a spreadsheet and cross them with whatever you need.
DOWNLOAD.NOTE: Stage, loss reason, labels, inbox, origin, origin date, agent and conversation number come from the contact's latest conversation. The list follows the audience's rule and window; for another period, create or edit an audience with that window.
DOWNLOAD.FORMAT_NOTE: CSV format, which opens directly in Excel and Google Sheets.
DOWNLOAD.SUCCESS: Download started. The file will be saved to your computer.

SAVE_AS.TITLE: Save as audience
SAVE_AS.DESCRIPTION: The audience starts with what you see here. Name it and choose whether it keeps updating or stays as it is now.
